The host labels it 1971, but the actual back page reviews 1972 results and Le Mans 1972; an exact model year is therefore left unknown. Technical pages specify the 1699 cc V4, 78 ch DIN, 14.4 m.daN and four-speed. Native rating units are retained. No earlier A or fixed-roof SX specification, other-source power rating, measured performance, mass, production count, galvanising claim or competition-car engine is imported. All original 530 versions belong to this one family.
cars.summary: The Matra 530 combined a compact mid-mounted V4 with genuine 2+2 accommodation and a removable two-piece roof. Separate body panels on a welded-sheet structure marked a significant step in Matra’s production-car construction, while independent suspension and four disc brakes supported its sporting role. This distinctive approach to an accessible mid-engine sports car earns one original 530 family entry, separate from the Djet, Bagheera and Murena. A, LX and SX versions do not add separate counts.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The Matra 530 combined a compact mid-mounted V4 with genuine 2+2 accommodation and a removable two-piece roof. Separate body panels on a welded-sheet structure marked a significant step in Matra’s production-car construction, while independent suspension and four disc brakes supported its sporting role. This distinctive approach to an accessible mid-engine sports car earns one original 530 family entry, separate from the Djet, Bagheera and Murena. A, LX and SX versions do not add separate counts.
